name: AICSS
summary: Freemium copy-paste UI for AI agents: thinking states, tool calls, streaming text, citations.
gaps: Pilot includes 12 free registry comps (HTTP 200 on /r/{slug}.json) — not full free inventory; Pro comps excluded.
Freemium: free MIT comps + CLI on GitHub/npm; Personal $89 once / Enterprise unlock remaining (registry returns HTTP 401 without AICSS_TOKEN).
Pro samples confirmed 401: audio-waves, image-generation, task-list, ai-agent-input, approval-card.
npm @aicss/react exports a subset of free comps; others install via shadcn registry / @aicss/cli.
Site ships React/Vue/Svelte; catalog frameworks list React/Next only.
iframe demos only; no dynamic-import smoke mounts in this packet.

components.name: Thinking State
components.summary: Minimal shimmering label that signals the agent is processing.

demo.peerNotes: self-contained CSS; React/Vue/Svelte variants on site

components.copyCode:
npx shadcn@latest add https://www.aicss.dev/r/thinking-state.json

# or: npm install @aicss/react && import from package
# or: npx @aicss/cli add thinking-state
import { ThinkingState } from "@aicss/react/thinking-state"

<ThinkingState />

copyPrompt.text: Use AICSS free MIT component `Thinking State` (slug `thinking-state`) from https://www.aicss.dev/components/thinking-state. Install with `npx shadcn@latest add https://www.aicss.dev/r/thinking-state.json` or `npx @aicss/cli add thinking-state` or `npm install @aicss/react` then `import { ThinkingState } from "@aicss/react/thinking-state"`. Registry item: https://www.aicss.dev/r/thinking-state.json (free tier returns HTTP 200; Pro comps return 401 without AICSS_TOKEN). Requires React (Vue/Svelte snippets also on site). Self-contained CSS — Tailwind not required in the app. License: MIT for free comps/CLI (https://raw.githubusercontent.com/kvnkld/aicss/main/LICENSE; site license page). Pricing freemium — free MIT comps only; Personal $89 / Enterprise paid unlocks excluded.
